error.message: rate-limit policy "authenticated-user" requires non-secret config "rate_limit_account" for its declared scope

diagnosis.local_stage: GitHub engine newRuntime rate-limit resolution before requester dispatch
diagnosis.affected_scope: GitHub only: every runtime request selected by the whole-connector authenticated-user policy; not shared all-connectors direct-read machinery
diagnosis.contract_gap: GitHub's declared config describes rate_limit_account as optional, but the matching runtime policy fails without it and CLI serializes that local configuration error as internal.

records.resolution: Use the approved non-secret account coordination subject in the target-scoped lab credential, then fix and test the configuration/error-classification contract before relying on this cohort.

records.limitation: repo view is the repository ETL stream, and its committed projected schema has no archived field; the successful PM control cannot establish that property.
records.resolution: The captain's independently verified unarchived state remains the authority for target admission; the boundary is pinned to the PM-read immutable repository ID and this control supplies no override flags.

records.resolution: Do not create or delete an organization until a PM-only creation path can bind one run-owned immutable organization target.
